## Où j'en suis

On branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2`, the draggable, resizable dashboard grid is built behind the `dashboards_v2` flag. Layout persists per user and dashboard through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, with a localStorage fallback. Widget sizing uses a ResizeObserver hook, so it works on iOS 15. `DashboardTile` is renamed `WidgetCard`, and the Storybook build is fixed. Draft PR #418 is open. It still needs Priya's UX review on iPad and the flag enabled for the Zest workspace before the demo on Tuesday 24th.

- [en-cours] Priya's UX review of the grid on iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15.7)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace in the flags admin, before the demo on Tuesday 24th
- [prochaine-étape] Mark PR #418 ready for review once the UX feedback is in
- [essai-raté] Container queries: ignored silently by iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+), so widgets never resized on Zest's iPads. Replaced by the ResizeObserver hook.
- [décision] Persist the layout server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, with localStorage only as fallback (source: t03)
- [décision] Drop container queries and use only the ResizeObserver hook, to avoid two sizing systems (source: t09)
- [décision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard`, keeping a deprecated re-export for the v1 list (source: t11)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards untouched behind the flag until January, remove nothing, and turn the flag on for Zest only (source: t15)
- [décision] Open the PR as a draft for Priya's UX review (source: t17)
